title: Liftoff Mobile raised $437M in its US IPO, selling 19M shares for $23 each, above its marketed range of $20 to $22, valuing the company at $3.83B (Natalia Kniazhevich/Bloomberg)
summary: Natalia Kniazhevich / Bloomberg: Liftoff Mobile raised $437M in its US IPO, selling 19M shares for $23 each, above its marketed range of $20 to $22, valuing the company at $3.83B — Liftoff Mobile Inc. raised $437 million in a US initial public offering that priced above its marketed range, in the company's second attempt at going public this year.
